scope: Proposition 3.1 (Uniform local moments) of the manuscript “A continuum temperature singularity for a radial pair potential” (preprints/A-continuum-temperature-singularity-for-a-radial-pair-potential-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 228 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d3c00f7387c84c30), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a compact set K ⊂ Ω. For all potentials in (2.3), all finite cubes, and all the modified systems just described, there is a constant CK such that Eβ,h[ninj] ≤ CK ((β, h) ∈ K) for every pair of cells meeting the cube. The constant is independent of the number and ranges of the attractive summands.
